summary: Iteration 4 backend delta (RBAC full coverage + Bundle Recommendation + Cron Scheduler): 30/30 pass (100%). Verified: (1) RBAC deny — staff with only [article.*, review.*] correctly 403'd on GET /api/admin/faqs, /api/admin/pages, /api/admin/contact-setting, /api/admin/lens/indexes; /api/admin/knowledge still 200 (uses article.view, per spec note). (2) RBAC grant — after temporarily adding setting.view+setting.update+product.view, staff can GET all 4 routes above (200); POST /api/admin/knowledge (200, article.create); POST/PUT /api/admin/faqs (200); POST/DELETE /api/admin/pages (200). Permissions restored to base after each test via autouse fixture. (3) Bundle Recommendation — GET /api/lens/recommended-bundle/{frame_id} returns 3 picks with tiers [basic,popular,premium]; each pick includes lens_product_id, lens_index_id, frame_price, lens_price, lens_index_price, bundle_total, original_total, savings; bundle_total math verified (= frame_price + lens_price + lens_index_price); 404 on unknown frame. (4) Bundle Checkout — POST /api/cart with lens_product_id+lens_index_id yields cart subtotal exactly matching pick.bundle_total. (5) Scheduler — GET /api/health returns {ok:true, scheduler_running:true}; GET /api/admin/scheduler/status (admin) returns 4 registered jobs; customer & staff both 403. (6) Manual trigger — POST /api/admin/scheduler/run/{job_id} returns {ok:true, job:<id>} for all 4 valid ids; unknown id returns {ok:false, error:...}. (7) Cron effect — Inserted pending_payment order with past reservation_expires_at → after run/expire-pending-orders → status='expired'; inserted flash_sale (is_active=false, start_at past, end_at future) → after run/activate-flash-sales → is_active=true. (8) Regression — admin/customer /auth/me + /vouchers/active pass.

minor.issue: Invalid job id returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false,error:...} rather than 400/404. Behaviorally OK (spec explicitly asked for {ok:false, error:...}), but from REST hygiene POV a 400 would be more idiomatic.
Uses current_admin (excludes staff even if given a scheduler.view perm). No permission catalog entry for scheduler mgmt — acceptable for MVP since scheduler is super_admin territory.

Still no staff@meoweyes.id seed (carry-over from iter3). Tests rely on out-of-band user creation. Recommend adding idempotent upsert with role=staff, permissions=BASE_STAFF_PERMS, PIN 111222 for reproducibility on DB wipe.

action_items: Consider seeding staff@meoweyes.id in seed.py (idempotent) for DB-wipe resilience.
Optional: return HTTP 400 for invalid scheduler job_id in POST /api/admin/scheduler/run/{job_id} instead of 200 + ok:false, for REST idiomaticity.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py: job_poll_shipments never advances carrier_status='delivered' to a customer-facing 'delivered' order status (kept at 'shipped' with comment 'customer still needs to confirm receipt'). This is intentional but means auto-complete-orders solely relies on shipment_checked_at/updated_at cutoff — worth documenting in the order lifecycle spec.

scheduler.py: AsyncIOScheduler singleton assumed process-global. If backend is ever scaled to >1 uvicorn worker (currently supervisor runs single worker), jobs will double-fire. Add a note or a mongodb-based lock if scaled.

routes_content.recommended_bundle: idx_sorted[min(1, len-1)] means when only 1 lens_index exists all 3 picks share the same index — acceptable degenerate case but worth guarding against len==1 lens_products which would repeat lens across tiers too.

routes_admin_content.py: full RBAC migration completed for knowledge/faq/pages/contact/lens-indexes. Consistent mapping (knowledge→article.*, faq/page/contact→setting.*, lens-indexes→product.*). Staff module now exposes every route in the permission catalog.

server.py scheduler_run_now: swallowing exceptions inside job functions (via internal try/except) but the endpoint itself doesn't try/except — if a job raises, admin gets a 500. Recommend wrapping fn() in try/except and returning {ok:false, error:str(e)}.
